dt: Nomination period Oct 15 - Jan 15, annually; this cycle closes Jan 15, 2027
e: Recognizes graduate students doing outstanding research on sensors; nominees must be enrolled at the nomination deadline, have at least one paper in an ECS journal on a Sensor Division topic, and be ECS members with the Sensor Division as their primary division. A supervisor's nomination letter is required.
n: ECS Sensor Division Student Research Award
unv: The page gives the annual Oct 15 - Jan 15 window; the 2027 closing date is taken from that annual window.
